descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S02 Pad opens from the list and adds boxes; room suggestion + Link places the exact text on that chart only; assign appends to the note as it stands, two boxes as separate pieces

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 4; TFA-92582 step 4; TFA-92583 AC 3)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium tests (an empty chart in a random four-digit room and a decoy in the same digits with the last two swapped) and Tim's API test (a patient whose encounter note is 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.', two empty compartments)

When Open the pad, add a compartment, type 'Bed <room>, telemetry likely artifact, no events overnight.', tap Link; separately assign a box through the picker; assign two compartments to one patient at the same moment from two clients

Then Pad full screen with one box, a second after New compartment; chip 'Rm <room>' and 'Matches on your list'; decoy not offered; chart empty until the tap, then exactly the box text; decoy chart empty. The two-client assign keeps the note's first paragraph and adds both boxes as their own paragraphs, each box marked with patient label, time and the text that w …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: encounterNotes toBe(text) on an empty chart (verbatim, U2); decoy button count 0 and decoy notes '' (U3, U6); paragraph 0 unchanged and paragraphs 1–2 equal the two box texts (U2 end of note; U6 boxes not merged); assignedLabel / assignedText / assignedAt set (U2 marked). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
